Full Trailer Wrap in Toronto

If you tow trailers frequently to work sites, around the city, or you have a unique business-like food truck or mobile service station, then you boost your branding with full trailer wraps from Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

Full Trailer Wrap is one of the most economical ways to promote your business in today’s competitive market. We specialize in branding trailers with only premium quality materials like Avery Dennison & 3M and we feature a large variety of wrap colours. Both leading brands back our business, as we have established trust wrapping hundreds of vehicles. You can check out more of our job here.

Your commercial and personal vehicles can effectively deliver your advertising message with custom full trailer wraps.

Our friendly staff can help you choose the right materials for full trailer wrap considering product durability, wraps colours, effective design layouts, removable options and so much more.

If you have any queries regarding trailer wrap, call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our workshop at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON M9W 1B4. You can also send us a message and our experts will get back to you.
